profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lightstream, a division of Truist Bank
profile.summary: A versatile professional with over 26 years of extensive experience in developing and managing a wide variety of mission-critical internet and intranet business applications. Proven success in designing optimized relational databases supporting high volume financial applications. Proficient in collaborating with key stakeholders, cross-functional teams and remote vendors for requirements elicitation and formulation of immediate resolution. Adept in implementing cost-efficient, scalable, user-centric and secure application architecture. Exemplary problem-solving skills and well-versed in strategy formulation to deliver high value solutions to clients.
